project_type: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript web app (OrientApp), migrated from a native Android vocational-diagnostic app. Deployable on Vercel with Neon Postgres + pgvector for a RAG knowledge base. Auth.js v5 (Google OAuth, JWT sessions, roles). Deployable app lives under web/; original Android sources under app/ must stay untouched.
build_system: npm (Node 22, sourced via nvm). Run all commands from web/. IMPORTANT: node/npm are only on PATH after sourcing nvm: `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22`.
test_framework: Vitest (vitest.config.ts), tests in web/tests/*.test.ts. Baseline is 115 tests passing. Pure-function engine tests follow web/tests/chaside-engine.test.ts and web/tests/tipov-engine.test.ts.
build_command: cd web && npm run build  (MUST succeed with NO env vars set — verify with `env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build`). All DB/AI/auth config is read lazily/at request time; do NOT break this invariant.
test_command: cd web && npx vitest --run  (or `npm run test -- --run`).
verification_instructions: From web/ after sourcing nvm: (1) npm run typecheck  (2) npm run lint  (3) npx vitest --run  (4) env -u DATABASE_URL -u AI_API_KEY npm run build. All four must pass. All user-facing text MUST be in Spanish.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in web/node_modules. If adding a dependency, add it to web/package.json and run npm install from web/. Network mode is OPEN_INTERNET so npm registry is reachable. Source nvm before any node/npm command.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET. NO live Neon Postgres and NO OpenAI/embeddings credentials in the sandbox, so a real end-to-end RAG ingestion CANNOT be executed here — validate only via typecheck/lint/tests/build and by making the ingestion script safe/degrading when DATABASE_URL/AI are unset. Do NOT push and do NOT create/modify PRs (orchestrator handles publishing). Work only on branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon.
contribution_requirements: Stay on branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon; commit onto it to extend open PR #1. Do NOT create a new branch, switch to main, or push. Keep app/ (Android) untouched. Keep all user-facing strings in Spanish. Preserve the no-env build invariant.
key_patterns: Pluggable method registry at web/lib/methods/: types.ts (VocationalMethod contract: id, dimensions, questions item bank, ResponseScale, pure score()->MethodResult), registry.ts (METHODS record, DEFAULT_METHOD_ID='RIASEC', getMethod/listMethods, normalizeMethodId funnels unknown ids to RIASEC). Existing methods: riasec-adapter.ts, chaside/ (data.ts+engine.ts), tipov/ (data.ts+engine.ts). Each method folder = data module (dimensions + item bank builder) + engine (pure score()). Item banks for CHASIDE/TIPOV are disclosed 'adaptaciones originales y fieles' (structure/scoring from the doc, wording original). Downstream is fully generic: web/app/api/sessions/route.ts scores ANY registered non-RIASEC method through the generic branch and persists method_id + method_scores JSONB (r/i/a/s/e/c stay 0); web/app/results/[sessionId]/page.tsx renders non-RIASEC via GenericMethodResults (per-dimension bars + interpretation) with a CHASIDE-only ChasideInteresAptitud dual panel keyed on session.methodId==="CHASIDE"; AI report (app/api/ai/report/route.ts) and tutor chat (app/api/ai/chat/route.ts + lib/ai/prompts.ts) already handle generic methods via method_scores. Method selector + cohort assignment: web/app/assessment/page.tsx + web/components/AssessmentClient.tsx (selector), web/components/AdminClient.tsx METHOD_OPTIONS list (id+name) drives cohort method dropdown, web/lib/actions/cohorts.ts + web/app/g/[code]/page.tsx build /assessment?cohort=CODE&method=METHOD. RAG ingest pipeline (do NOT rebuild): web/lib/knowledge/ingest.ts (ingestDocument({title, sourceType:'BOOK'|'RESEARCH'|'ARTICLE', sourceReference, content, createdBy}) chunks via chunkText, embeds via embedTexts, inserts knowledge_documents + knowledge_chunks; if AI unconfigured stores chunks with NULL embedding + warning; listDocuments()), web/lib/knowledge/chunk.ts (pure chunkText), web/lib/knowledge/retrieve.ts, web/lib/ai/client.ts (embedTexts/embedText), web/lib/ai/config.ts (EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=1536, resolveAiConfig lazy). DB schema: web/db/schema.sql (knowledge_documents/knowledge_chunks with vector(1536); idempotent CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS + ALTER ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migrations). Seed-script pattern to mirror: web/scripts/seed.ts + npm script db:seed = 'tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/seed.ts' (reads DATABASE_URL lazily via lib/db, applies schema.sql statement-by-statement, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, exits with Spanish message if DATABASE_URL unset).
directory_structure: web/lib/methods/ = pluggable method registry (types.ts, registry.ts, riasec-adapter.ts, chaside/, tipov/). web/lib/knowledge/ = RAG pipeline (chunk.ts, ingest.ts, retrieve.ts). web/lib/ai/ = AI client + config. web/db/schema.sql = authoritative Neon schema. web/scripts/ = seed.ts (npm run db:seed). web/app/ = App Router pages/routes (assessment, results/[sessionId], g/[code], api/sessions, api/ai/*, api/knowledge, admin/*). web/components/ = client components (AssessmentClient, AdminClient, KnowledgeAdminClient, etc.). web/tests/ = Vitest suites. skills/knowledge/ = uploaded source docs (repo root, one level up from web/): .md files + one PDF 'Diseño de un instrumento de orientación vocacional.pdf'.
